about: Client form schema v1 answer checks (docs/forms/WAVE34-CONTRACT.md 3.1). The SQL checker cockpit_form_answers_check and the portal's client-form-schema.ts validateAnswers must give exactly these ok and errors for every row. Written by invites-core; portal-forms copies this file byte for byte into tests/fixtures/client-form-answers.json (D0 compares them with cmp). Codes: required, range, option, length, unknown, hidden. A wrong JSON type answers range for a scale, option for a choice, multi or tick, and required for a text. A question is shown when its showIf holds on the checked earlier answer; an unanswered tick reads false. A context that carries signer (the link page's typed name) is checked under the key signer when the schema's signer is typed.

wave5About: Waves 5-6 additions (docs/forms/WAVE56-CONTRACT.md 3.6), kept apart so the waves 3-4 checker's test reads only schemas and rows. Written by client-tail; portal-56 copies this file byte for byte. New types: file, date, number, heading; text format plain, url, email, phone. New codes: file_missing (a required file absent, an answer that is not a file object, or no slot of this invite and field, or no object in the bucket cockpit-form-files at that path), file_type (a type the question does not take, or Storage's mimetype differs), file_size (over maxBytes, or Storage's size differs), format, and range for a date outside its window or a number outside min, max or decimals. A heading is never answered (unknown if sent). Dates written {today}, {today-N} or {today+N} are Kuwait's date when the test runs. A row with files seeds invite 00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000f001 (form bank_receipt, the row's context without signer), a slot for each file whose slot is true and a storage object for each object that is not null. sqlOnly rows depend on what Storage and the slots hold: the portal's mirror checks the shape and skips their expected codes.

schemaV2About: Client form schema version 2 (docs/forms/WAVE56-CONTRACT.md 4.22), the structured onboarding's language, kept apart so the version-1 tests read only their own parts. Written by onboarding-schema-v2 (B8); the client portal's client-form-schema-v2 (P2) copies this file byte for byte. A version-2 schema is the client onboarding's only, so its key is onboarding and its texts are kept as typed (line breaks as line feeds, both ends trimmed). New: rows (columns text, longtext, number, choice, tick; minRows, maxRows, addLabel), note (shown, never answered: unknown if sent), showIf with exactly one of equals, in (the checked answer is one of the list) or includes (the checked list holds the value), currencyFrom (display only). A question whose source is hidden or unanswered is hidden; an unanswered tick reads false. A rows answer is a list of objects; a row whose every cell is missing, null, a blank text or false is dropped before rows are counted; an answer that is not a list of objects answers required. A required rows question needs max(1, minRows) rows: none is required, fewer is rows_few, more than maxRows is rows_many; an optional one may be left empty, and once it has rows it takes minRows to maxRows of them. A cell's code (required, length, range, option, unknown) is keyed <question>.<row>.<column>, the row counted from 0 in the list as sent. stored is what the check keeps: the rows with something in them, each with its checked cells only; a rows question with any error keeps nothing.
